scenario: bounded 24-character text-editing burst in the large fixture document

display.note: Logical window size equals pixel size in this capture; no DPI transition was exercised.

theme: Scratchpad default Warm theme; no appearance fixture or preference was set.
sequence: 24 committed character insertions at the editor caret, one per step
sequence_driver: Benchmark-only scheduled hook opens the large fixture document, waits for the bounded source window, then delivers 24 committed text-input events through editor_text_input (the same application path platform text input reaches). It does not synthesize native key or pointer events.
sequence_cadence: Typing starts 500 ms after start once the fixture document window is ready; each character advances after the previous character description was built, with a 30 ms floor. The last character waits for its closing description before completion is declared.
renderer: SDL_GPU reference host (build carries both renderers; no SCRATCHPAD_RENDERER override was set)
smoke_window: The reference host exits smoke at its fixed 3 s window; every process completed the 24-character burst inside it.
